aluminum.author: ambientCG / Lennart Demes (site operator; no separate per-asset author field)
aluminum.coverage_note: Zero means unspecified by upstream; do not infer real-world scale.
aluminum.identity_notes: Official aluminum/brushed source with circular brushing. Texture does not establish a uniform linear brush tangent.

Direction.modifications: Periodic central differences of original normalized16-bit Height provide actual source slopes. Periodic Gaussian sigma4px smooths gx^2,gx*gy,gy^2. Dominant eigenvector is slope; brush tangent is its perpendicular. Confidence=(lambdaMax-lambdaMin)/(lambdaMax+lambdaMin+1e-14). No invented radial centers.
Direction.use: Decode after linear filtering; multiply anisotropy by B and preferably filtered RG vector length when distant. BrushRotation adds an explicit global rotation.

Normal.limitation: Scale .03 is an explicit chosen microrelief strength, not measured physical depth. Original NormalDX retained unchanged in original_normal.
Normal.modifications: Periodic central differences in U/V of normalized16-bit source Height, divided by2*texel; N=normalize(-dHdu*.03,-dHdv*.03,1). Encoded DirectX8-bit tangent space. Both XY gradient signs agree with upstream Tile/Oak/Leather NormalDX-height correlations below-.89.
Normal.normal_convention: DirectX tangent space (+X,-Y,+Z); do not flip green on import

aluminum.orientation_source_note: Raw source NormalDX tensor gave ambiguous near-uniform -45deg orientation. Independent full16 Non-Color Blender decode found XY correlation .99924 and median decoded normal length .9035. Cause not established; no upstream defect claim. Runtime normal and Direction instead share authored Height. The initial normal-tensor map is retained as a candidate diagnostic.

original_normal.normal_convention: DirectX tangent space (+X,-Y,+Z); do not flip green on import

rotation_convention.limitation: Exact lobe handedness/90-degree principal-axis agreement between Blender and Unreal still requires rendered inspection; BrushRotation is the explicit adjustment.
rotation_convention.upstream: 0..1 is one full turn; theta=2*pi*value relative to UV tangent
rotation_convention.verification: Official crepe_satin_1k.blend connects Non-Color anisotropy_rotation directly to Principled Anisotropic Rotation, and Non-Color anisotropy_strength directly to Anisotropic. Read-only headless Blender node inspection.
